items.title: Home Depot Paid Shareholders $68 Billion. The Stock Still Lagged.
items.summary: The home improvement giant showered its owners with cash, yet the stock fell far behind the market. Here is the accounting of what investors actually got, and what the trade-off cost them.

items.title: PCG Passed Our Value-Trap Test. Now What?

items.title: QCOM: A Cash Gusher At A Marked-Down Price

items.title: SanDisk Has Delivered A Return The Index Cannot, And The Swings That Come With It

items.title: Coeur Mining Stock Is Priced On Its Margin

items.title: UiPath Stock Carries A Market Multiple On Earnings And A Premium On Sales
